description: SimCenter Hurricane Testbed: Lake Charles, LA is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Gregory Deierlein, Stanford University (stanford.edu). This project contains the inputs (inventories, rulesets, hazard data), outputs (enriched inventory data, results), and documentation used in this release of the SimCenter’s Lake Charles, LA testbed. This testbed serves as a demonstration site for the hurricane regional loss estimation workflow. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-jpj2-zx14. Keywords: SimCenter, Testbed, Hurricane, Louisiana, Lake Charles, Hurricane Laura. Published 2021-09-12. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
